0022600004.text: Both the Miami Heat and the Minnesota Timberwolves open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, which Miami hosts. Minnesota will be without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out following Achilles surgery, and Ayo Dosunmu is day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision. The Heat lost 0-2 to Minnesota in the 2025-26 season series, most recently 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Miami a 50% chance to win.
